question: Can current SignCraft inference generation directly propose an against-side move when the supported closure basis entails a denied conclusion?

observations: enabledMoves skips every basis conclusion satisfying isDenied(a)
realized-continuation moves range over ctx.M base attributes and never construct a NEG-prefixed candidate
opened and closed simulate every candidate by adjoining the reading potential
heldSigned carries for-side and against-side evidence into one signed closure input
sigma forces a denied conclusion into the active reading and emits a neg-lane witness

existingDenialFixture.fixture: penguins are witnessed penguin+bird and denied flies; robins are bird+flies
existingDenialFixture.existingAssertion: lawfulBasis contains a supported implication with penguin in the premise and NEG+flies in the conclusion; settling a fresh penguin derives flies=active with a neg-lane witness

energy.observation: disagreementEnergyChange uses a single held-for indicator x and computes the energy change for gaining a positive attribute; no against-seed analogue is defined

derivedResult.statement: Every move current enabledMoves can return is an unsigned base attribute, and current generation evaluates it by adding for-side evidence. Therefore generate() is positive-seeded even though its closure substrate is signed.

minimalCounterexample.generationPrediction: enabledMoves does not return an against-side flies candidate because denied basis conclusions are skipped
minimalCounterexample.whyItDiscriminates: the same supported negative consequence is available to settlement but unavailable as a direct generation seed

designImplications.reading: Treat generate() as constructive/positive continuation and define a distinct refutational or against-side proposal operation if autonomous denial proposals are needed.
designImplications.support: This matches the current source boundary and has a literature precedent in Fitting's dual refutation mechanism for four-valued logic programming.

designImplications.reading: Generalize the move carrier to include a lane/sign and allow both positive and negative seeds.
missingSemantics: closed currently counts the positive-only enabled cone
disagreementEnergyChange currently measures a for-side held indicator only
sampling witness currently names only attr, not lane
stable/contested behavior under a signed seed needs explicit tests

assumptions: FOUR evidence lanes are treated as a product carrier for this metric
conductance is the same on both evidence lanes
there is no cross-lane coupling term
candidateEnergyExtension.formula: E_K(x_plus,x_minus)=x_plus^T L x_plus + x_minus^T L x_minus
candidateEnergyExtension.consequence: Under these assumptions, a negative seed has the same local Laplacian update law on x_minus that a positive seed has on x_plus.
candidateEnergyExtension.caution: The assumptions are scientific choices, not consequences of current code. A separate contradiction/frustration term may be required if cross-lane conflict is meant to carry energetic cost.

externalLineage.citation: Melvin Fitting, Negation as refutation, LICS 1989
externalLineage.relevance: demonstrates a refutation mechanism dual to proof in a Belnap four-valued setting

externalLineage.citation: Melvin Fitting, Logic Programming on a Topological Bilattice, Fundamenta Informaticae 11(2), 1988
externalLineage.relevance: treats truth values as evidence for and against in bilattice-based logic programming

refusalConditions: Do not call current generate() a general signed inference generator.
Do not add against-side candidates by only tagging moves with a sign while leaving the present positive-only energy and closed/opened definitions unchanged.
Do not infer that a generated denial is warranted merely because settlement could derive a denied conclusion.

Do not treat the absence of a discovered complementary operation as proof that none exists; repository code search indexing was unavailable and this assay inspected the current inference source and tests directly.

checks: lawfulBasis contains the supported denied flies conclusion
settle on a fresh penguin yields flies=active with a neg-lane witness
enabledMoves for the same pre-settlement seed contains no direct against-side flies move
the test records whether any positive candidate can indirectly trigger the denial after settlement
engineeringAcceptanceTest.purpose: Make the current asymmetry executable and regression-visible without yet changing behavior.
